framework: ScoreSentinel Enterprise AML & Model Risk Governance (SR 11-7 / FinCEN / FATF)

scenarios.name: Structuring / Smurfing Pattern Detection
scenarios.regulatory_citation: FinCEN Advisory FIN-2012-A008 / BSA 31 U.S.C. § 5324 / FATF Rec 20
scenarios.description: Detects multiple transactions conducted intentionally below the statutory Currency Transaction Report (CTR) threshold ($10,000) within a rolling time window to evade mandatory regulatory reporting.

parameter_definitions.lower_bound: Minimum transaction amount to qualify for structuring consideration ($).
parameter_definitions.upper_bound: Maximum transaction amount just under CTR reporting limit ($).
parameter_definitions.lookback_days: Rolling window size in days to aggregate transactions.
parameter_definitions.min_tx_count: Minimum number of transactions within the window required to trigger breach.
parameter_definitions.round_number_tolerance: Modulus tolerance to flag intentional round-number avoidance.
parameter_definitions.aggregate_threshold_check: Secondary aggregate amount within window that triggers elevated severity.

scenarios.name: Rapid Movement of Funds / Pass-Through Mule Account
scenarios.regulatory_citation: FATF Guidance on Money Mule Networks / FinCEN Advisory FIN-2020-A003
scenarios.description: Identifies rapid dissipation of funds where substantial incoming credits are transferred out (debited) almost immediately, indicative of pass-through mule or layering operations with minimal residual balance.

parameter_definitions.inflow_window_hours: Lookback window in hours to measure cumulative inflow credits.
parameter_definitions.outflow_ratio: Minimum ratio of outflows to inflows (0.0 - 1.0) indicating rapid dissipation.
parameter_definitions.min_amount: Minimum total credit inflow amount required to activate scenario ($).
parameter_definitions.max_retention_hours: Maximum elapsed hours between inflow and subsequent outflow.

scenarios.name: High-Risk Corridor Spike & Velocity Deviation
scenarios.typology: Cross-Border Geographic Flight & Sanctions / Grey List Evasion
scenarios.regulatory_citation: FATF Recommendation 19 (Higher-Risk Countries) / OFAC Risk Matrix / Wolfsberg Guidance
scenarios.description: Flags abnormal surges in transaction volume or frequency directed to or originating from FATF Black/Grey list jurisdictions or offshore financial secrecy havens when deviating sharply from customer historical baseline.

parameter_definitions.corridor_risk_weight_threshold: Minimum cumulative geographic risk score required for high-risk classification.
parameter_definitions.velocity_multiplier: Spike multiplier compared to 30-day customer historical volume average (e.g. 3.0 = 300%).
parameter_definitions.min_corridor_amount: Minimum single transaction value to consider for corridor escalation ($).
parameter_definitions.fatf_greylist_boost: Score additive boost when dealing with FATF Grey List counterparties.
